lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis across Mozambique. Geographic polygons represent areas classified into IPC phases (1-5) indicating severity of acute food insecurity. Data includes multiple scenarios and is used to project near-term food security conditions.
